contenu:
name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

variables:
  - name: disable.coverage.autogenerate
    value: "true"

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      prepare_scanner_mode: "MSBuild"

      step_postPrepare:
        - task: NuGetAuthenticate@1
          displayName: 🔐 Authenticate to MTAFFeed (faurecia-gtf)
          inputs:
            nuGetServiceConnections: 'faurecia-gtf-mtaf-nuget-feed'

        - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
          displayName: 🗃️ Restore Solution
          inputs:
            command: 'restore'
            projects: '**/*.slnx'
            feedsToUse: 'config'
            nugetConfigPath: 'MESXTestAuto/nuget.config'

        - template: steps/dotnet-restore-build-test.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            testRunTitle: "SonarQube test run"
            dotnetVersion: "10.x"
            dotnetProjects : "MESXTestAuto/*.slnx"
            run_tests: false
            run_restore: false

      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.cs.vstest.reportsPaths=$(Agent.TempDirectory)/**/*.trx
        sonar.coverage.exclusions=**/Migrations/*.cs,**/*Tests*/**/*
        sonar.cs.opencover.reportsPaths=**/coverage.opencover.xml
        sonar.cpd.exclusions=**/Migrations/*.cs
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria=useconstant,emptymethod
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.useconstant.ruleKey=csharpsquid:S1192
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.useconstant.resourceKey=**/Migrations/*.cs
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.emptymethod.ruleKey=csharpsquid:S1186
        sonar.issue.ignore.multicriteria.emptymethod.resourceKey=**/Migrations/*.cs

trigger:
- main

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: 'mesx-resource-api'
    type: 'git'
    name: 'MES_X.0/mesx-resource-api'
  pipelines:
  - pipeline: TriggeringPipeline
    project: MES_X.0
    source: mesx-resource-api
    trigger:
      branches:
        include:
        - main
      stages:
        - Build

variables:
- group: app_component_test_resource_api
 
pool: 
  ubuntu-2204-vmss
 
steps:
- checkout: self
  fetchDepth: 1
- checkout: mesx-resource-api
  fetchDepth: 1
  
- task: Docker@2
  displayName: Login to MESX ACR
  inputs:
    containerRegistry: acrgptmpxp01static01.azurecr.io
    command: login

- script: |
    docker pull acrgptmpxp01static01.azurecr.io/mesx/resource-api:latest-unstable
    docker tag acrgptmpxp01static01.azurecr.io/mesx/resource-api:latest-unstable resource-api:local
  displayName: Pull and re-tag resource-api image

- script: |
    docker compose up -d
  workingDirectory: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/mesx-resource-api
  displayName: Start infrastructure with Docker Compose
  env:
    DB_PASSWORD: $(DB_PASSWORD)
    APP_CONFIG_KEY_SECRET: $(APP_CONFIG_KEY_SECRET)

- task: NuGetAuthenticate@1
  displayName: Authenticate to MTAFFeed (faurecia-gtf)
  inputs:
    nuGetServiceConnections: 'faurecia-gtf-mtaf-nuget-feed'

- task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
  displayName: Restore Solution
  inputs:
    command: 'restore'
    projects: 'mesx-resource-api-component-tests/MESXTestAuto/*.slnx'
    feedsToUse: 'config'
    nugetConfigPath: 'mesx-resource-api-component-tests/MESXTestAuto/nuget.config'
- task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
  displayName: Build Solution
  inputs:
    command: 'build'
    projects: 'mesx-resource-api-component-tests/MESXTestAuto/*.slnx'
    arguments: '--no-restore -c Release' 
- task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
  displayName: Run Tests
  inputs:
    command: 'test'
    projects: 'mesx-resource-api-component-tests/MESXTestAuto/*.slnx'
    arguments: '--no-build -c Release'
